params.body:
## Why

Today is the acceptance run with Ilse and tomorrow is the cutover. The questions only she can answer
were spread over `docs/acceptatietest.md` (V-1 to V-10), the findings list, and this weekend's work.
Nothing to hold during the session. Documentation only: no behaviour changed.

## What

- `docs/acceptatietest.md`: V-11 to V-16 in the existing table shape (question, option A with its
  consequence, option B with its consequence), each cross-referenced to its X finding.
  - V-11 and V-12 (X-80, new): "Pica" in the paint list, next to "Mica" and "Mica tweekleurig", and
    "Aangepast", which names no paint type. Both hang off existing vehicles, so merging or dropping
    means repointing those vehicles; split into two questions because each has its own answer.
  - V-13 (X-81, new): `RemoveBgKey::resolve()` takes the first `settings.api_key` row with no dealer
    filter, so one dealer's credits pay for every dealer's photos. The class docblock already says
    this is older than the encryption change and was left as it is; the question is whether that is
    one platform account on purpose.
  - V-14 (X-75), V-15 (X-78), V-16 (X-79): X findings that were still waiting for a decision and had
    no question yet.
- `docs/bedrijfsregels/90-x-bevindingen.md`: X-80 (paint list, ernst later, Ilse decides) and X-81
  (remove.bg key, ernst deze week, Frederik decides because it is about who pays).
- `docs/vragen-ilse-2026-09-14.md`: the one-page sheet. Only open questions, grouped by subject
  (biedingen, Car-Pass, prijzen en btw, showroom, wagenfiche, integraties, de overzet), each in at
  most three lines with the two options on one line each and a line to write the answer. It opens
  with which eight must be decided today and which eight can wait.
- `92-testdekking.md` and `bedrijfsregels.html` regenerated with `bin/rules-coverage --write` and
  `bin/rules-page`, as earlier PRs did after touching a rules file. Note: the snapshot moved from 73
  to 74 covered rules (S1 20% to 21%). That is drift already on main, not from this PR; a test gained
  a `@rule` tag without the snapshot being refreshed.

`php artisan test --filter='RulesCoverage|Rules'` is green (the runner reports a warning about a
missing .env in the worktree; `vendor/bin/phpunit tests/Feature/RulesCoverageTest.php` is OK, 1 test,
1 assertion). `bin/rules-coverage` exits 0, so no `@rule` tag points at a rule that does not exist.

## Which questions I judged still open, and why

`docs/acceptatietest.md` has no answer column and nothing in the git history records an answer to
V-1 to V-10, so I treated all ten as open. Correct me where that is wrong.

- V-1 to V-5: open. X-01 to X-05 are all still in the findings table with ernst `nu`.
- V-6: open. PR 112 added `REAL_GARANT_HISTORY_EMAIL` (X-11), but the address itself is still the
  temporary De Backer one, so the question stands.
- V-7, V-8: open, nothing recorded.
- V-9: open. X-73 still asks it; the code stores `vat_percentage` from 13 September on, the older
  documents are untouched.
- V-10: open. X-77 says explicitly that behaviour per screen is unchanged until Ilse decides.
- V-11 to V-16: new today.

Today versus later, my reasoning: V-1 to V-5 because from tomorrow a bidding is a real bidding and a
Car-Pass request is a real registration; V-10 because five screens show a customer a different price
for the same car; V-13 because the credits are money and it is one account today; V-8 because it is
the plan for tomorrow morning. The rest costs no dealer any work if the answer comes a week later.

## What I could not judge

- Whether V-14 (the lease banner on every showroom slide) should be a today decision. A banner
  promising leasing at a dealer who does not offer it is a promise to a customer, but X-75 has ernst
  `deze week`, so I left it under "can wait" and said why.
- Who decides V-13. The X row says Frederik, because it is about who pays for the credits; the sheet
  notes that in one line so Ilse can relay it rather than being asked to decide alone.
- Whether X-74 (margin counted twice on a margin car in the showroom) needs a question of its own. I
  left it without one: it is a plain miscalculation and X-77 already carries it inside V-10.
- I could not verify "Pica" and "Aangepast" in the repo. They are rows in `vehicle_paint_types`, so
  they live in the data, not in the code; the finding is written from your observation.
params.title: Acceptance test: one sheet with the questions for Ilse
